goal: Prove the whole loop works from a cold start and document it: boot, submit goal, watch tasks complete, lessons persisted
summary: Phase 4 delivered the cold-start proof and documentation. scripts/smoke.mjs: single-command E2E that bootstraps the full backend in-process (tsx/esm/api register, temp SQLite db, seed-if-empty 3 agents, createApp + http server + WS hub on listen(0) with real port introspection), POSTs a goal, collects all 4 live WS event types, polls /state to all-terminal within a 20s bound, asserts 4 non-empty persisted lessons, and tears everything down — deterministic seed 42, ~0.5s per run, verified twice consecutively with no residue, exit codes 0/1/2 with SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup. README.md (136 lines) documents the pitch, Node >=22 prerequisites, quickstart demo flow, scripts (only those existing), ASCII architecture with per-module one-liners, full REST (6 routes, exact error shapes) and WS references, env vars, canonical types note, and the deferred scope list; a claim-by-claim source audit found zero unbacked statements. Root gates green: npm test 113/113, lint 0, typecheck 0.
